amily":"communication"},{"id":"pr_think","name":"think","definition":"某主体内心的想法、判断或推测，内容以文本记录。","roles":[{"name":"thinker","valueKinds":["entity"]},{"name":"content","valueKinds":["text"]}],"symmetric":false,"family":"mental"},{"id":"pr_selfname","name":"self_name","definition":"某主体自称或被称作某一名称。","roles":[{"name":"entity","valueKinds":["entity"]},{"name":"name","valueKinds":["text"]}],"symmetric":false,"family":"naming"},{"id":"pr_reborn_as","name":"reborn_as","definition":"某意识或存在重生为某一新的身体或形态。","roles":[{"name":"person","valueKinds":["entity"]},{"name":"body","valueKinds":["entity"]}],"symmetric":false,"family":"existence"},{"id":"pr_faint","name":"lose_consciousness","definition":"某主体突然胸口疼痛并眼前一黑、失去意识。","roles":[{"name":"person","valueKinds":["entity"]}],"symmetric":false,"family":"state"},{"id":"pr_assign_tasks","name":"assign_tasks","definition":"某存在为某一对象量身定制一整套任务。","roles":[{"name":"assigner","valueKinds":["entity"]},{"name":"beneficiary","valueKinds":["entity"]},{"name":"task","valueKinds":["text"]}],"symmetric":false,"family":"task"}],"times":[{"id":"t_death","at":15,"description":"大约在当下场景五分钟前：苏天晴结束连续三个夜班下班后在街边面摊吃面、随后胸口一疼眼前一黑的时间","precision":"relative","before":[],"after":[]},{"id":"t_present","at":4,"description":"苏天晴在昏暗房间内与浮空黑色古书对话的当下时段","precision":"interval","before":[],"after":[]}],"facts":[{"id":"f_su_name","at":5,"text":"苏天晴回答对方的询问，说出自己的名字是苏天晴。","predicate":"pr_selfname","arguments":[{"role":"entity","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}},{"role":"name","value":{"type":"text","text":"苏天晴"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"speech","holder":"e_su","opaque":true},"time":"t_present","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_su"],"proof":{"premises":["d1"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第4-5段有声音询问姓名、女声回答“苏天晴”，直接支持该自称发言。"}},{"id":"f_faint","at":15,"text":"苏天晴在连续三个夜班下班后，坐在街边面摊吃加了煎蛋的豪华牛肉面时，突然胸口一疼、眼前一黑，昏死过去。","predicate":"pr_faint","arguments":[{"role":"person","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"world","holder":null,"opaque":false},"time":"t_death","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_su"],"proof":{"premises":["d6"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第15段叙述苏天晴下班吃面时胸口一疼、眼前一黑昏死过去。"}},{"id":"f_grandma_voice","at":15,"text":"苏天晴在昏死前听到太奶在背后说话，回头看见太奶坐在藤椅上悠闲地编着一只围巾。","predicate":"pr_speak","arguments":[{"role":"speaker","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_grandma"}},{"role":"addressee","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}},{"role":"content","value":{"type":"unknown","reason":"原文只写太奶在背后说话，未给出说话的具体内容"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"speech","holder":"e_grandma","opaque":true},"time":"t_death","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_grandma","id_su"],"proof":{"premises":["d6"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第15段写苏天晴听到太奶在背后说话并回头看见太奶编围巾，说话内容原文未给出。"}},{"id":"f_rebirth","at":25,"text":"苏天晴认为自己重生成了镜中那只金毛狐女。","predicate":"pr_reborn_as","arguments":[{"role":"person","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}},{"role":"body","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_foxbody"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"belief","holder":"e_su","opaque":true},"time":"t_present","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_su","id_foxbody"],"proof":{"premises":["d11","d3"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第24-25段为苏天晴的想法“我重生了，重生成了一只金毛狐女”，配合第7-11段镜中所见的狐女身影。"}},{"id":"f_book_intro","at":30,"text":"黑色古书自称名为墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找它最优秀的适格者，并告诉苏天晴那个人就是她。","predicate":"pr_speak","arguments":[{"role":"speaker","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_book"}},{"role":"addressee","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}},{"role":"content","value":{"type":"text","text":"吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"speech","holder":"e_book","opaque":true},"time":"t_present","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_book","id_su"],"proof":{"premises":["d14"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第28-30段古书重复开场白，自称墨丘利秘典并指认苏天晴为适格者。"}},{"id":"f_book_knows","at":40,"text":"苏天晴认为这本书知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人。","predicate":"pr_think","arguments":[{"role":"thinker","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}},{"role":"content","value":{"type":"text","text":"这本书（墨丘利秘典）知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"belief","holder":"e_su","opaque":true},"time":"t_present","quantifier":"particular","modality":"possible","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_su"],"proof":{"premises":["d20"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第39-40段写苏天晴心中推测这本书知道自己不是原主，属她的猜测。"}},{"id":"f_book_offer","at":44,"text":"墨丘利秘典自称星界使者，称会引导苏天晴走上完美的生活，并要求她与自己签订一个小小的契约。","predicate":"pr_speak","arguments":[{"role":"speaker","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_book"}},{"role":"addressee","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}},{"role":"content","value":{"type":"text","text":"你是墨丘利秘典的最佳适格者，作为星界使者，我会引导你走上完美的生活，而你只需要与我签订一个小小的契约——"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"speech","holder":"e_book","opaque":true},"time":"t_present","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_book","id_su"],"proof":{"premises":["d22"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第43-44段古书自称星界使者、承诺引导其走上完美生活并邀其签约。"}},{"id":"f_su_wishes","at":55,"text":"苏天晴说世界上最通用的两个愿望是取之不尽的财富和变成萝莉，并说变成萝莉本身就是最大的奖励，更何况还是这样一只可爱的狐狐。","predicate":"pr_speak","arguments":[{"role":"speaker","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}},{"role":"addressee","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_book"}},{"role":"content","value":{"type":"text","text":"取之不尽的财富！以及变成萝莉！这是世界上最通用的两个愿望！变成萝莉本身就是最大的奖励，更何况还是这样一只可爱的狐狐！"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"speech","holder":"e_su","opaque":true},"time":"t_present","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_su","id_book"],"proof":{"premises":["d28"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第50-55段苏天晴对古书说出两个最通用的愿望并称狐狐形态是最大奖励。"}},{"id":"f_su_agree","at":59,"text":"苏天晴不假思索地同意签订契约，先回答“好，我签”，随后又回答“成立”。","predicate":"pr_speak","arguments":[{"role":"speaker","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}},{"role":"addressee","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_book"}},{"role":"content","value":{"type":"text","text":"好，我签。……成立。"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"speech","holder":"e_su","opaque":true},"time":"t_present","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_su","id_book"],"proof":{"premises":["d23","d31"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第45段苏天晴答“好，我签”，第59段不假思索回答“成立”。"}},{"id":"f_contract_content","at":64,"text":"古书回答契约的具体内容为“反派魔法少女”。","predicate":"pr_speak","arguments":[{"role":"speaker","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_book"}},{"role":"addressee","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}},{"role":"content","value":{"type":"text","text":"反派魔法少女。"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"speech","holder":"e_book","opaque":true},"time":"t_present","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_book","id_su"],"proof":{"premises":["d34"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第63-64段古书答契约内容是“反派魔法少女”。"}},{"id":"f_book_tasks","at":66,"text":"古书说明契约已经签订，从今天开始苏天晴将成为魔法少女活跃于世；造物主给她量身定制了一整套任务，能帮助她逐步走上反派魔法少女的顶点。","predicate":"pr_speak","arguments":[{"role":"speaker","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_book"}},{"role":"addressee","value":{"type":"ref","id":"e_su"}},{"role":"content","value":{"type":"text","text":"既然契约已经签订，那么从今天开始，你就将成为魔法少女活跃于世，造物主给你量身定制了一整套任务，能帮助你逐步走上反派魔法少女的顶点！"}}],"polarity":"affirmativ
